verdict.rationale: Paddle Billing natively retries failed payments on automatically-collected subscriptions up to seven times over a 30-day window. Paddle Retain's Payment Recovery adds Tactical Retries, configurable failed-payment email notifications, in-app retry forms, and a choice of what happens to past-due subscriptions. Missing for 10: smart retries and recovery emails require integrating the separate Paddle Retain product, Retain cannot be tested in sandbox, there is little detail on email customization or retry logic, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
